call_order: EULER_BEFORE is before gas and SST recovery; it is not the final source evaluation state.

Gas recovery -> SST recovery -> boundary refresh/preparation -> existing wall projection -> gas gradU -> F2/nut -> gas final face flux/periodic/positivity -> current gradK/gradOmega/F1 -> SST face flux/periodic.
SST_BEFORE samples actual source inputs immediately before applySstFluxAndSource; its full Euler source uses oldVolume and old gas density.
Wall omega RHS suppressed during SST Euler. Moving wall candidate rescales old inventory/newVolume. FLUX_BEFORE is after that update and before gas divergence.
Gas divergence -> gas recovery -> SST recovery/floor/wall projection -> EULER_AFTER.
BLEND_BEFORE -> raw conservative blend -> gas recovery -> SST recovery/floor/wall projection -> BLEND_AFTER. The endpoint is not raw omega density blend.

FinaliseGasBoundaryStage refreshes boundary mirrors/wave pressure, not another SST recovery. FinaliseGasTrialSources recovers gas after the second chemistry half, not SST. Do not conflate those endpoints with BLEND_AFTER.

component_formulas.velocity_invariants: Aij=actual gradUij; tr=sum Aii; S2=2*sum(((Aij+Aji)/2)^2); GbyNu=sum((Aij+Aji-deltaij*(2/3)*tr)*Aij). tr is not the finalized-flux divU used for compression.
component_formulas.net_sources: K=P-D-C; omega=P-D-C+cross. Terms are independently evaluated from actual consumed stage inputs, not recovered by adding destruction back to rounded net source.
component_formulas.stage_volume_and_time: Each Euler physical contribution=dt*oldVolume*source; face=dt*final_signed_flux. RK2 final effective coefficients .5,.5; RK3 1/6,1/6,2/3. Per-cell floor and wall constraint updates are separate, also subject to later RK blending.
component_formulas.lowRe_wall_projection: For each attached boundary face kind2: wallRho=cell primitive rho, except TFix then p/max(R*Twall,OfSmall); nu=gasMu/max(wallRho,rhoMin); target=6*nu/(beta1*max(wallDistance,1e-300)^2). omegaAfter=max(finiteOr(mean(target),omegaMin),omegaMin); rhoOmegaAfter=max(recovered cell rho,rhoMin)*omegaAfter.
component_formulas.raw_RK_and_recovery: raw rhoOmega=a*rhoOmegaInitial+b*rhoOmegaBefore; floor=max(finiteOr(raw,rhoSafe*omegaMin),rhoSafe*omegaMin). Unconstrained final=floor. Constrained final=rhoSafe*target. Independently computed floor correction and wall projection difference must be reported in stage volume inventories.
component_formulas.ALE_compression: Outward sum of final gasPhiRho/actual sstFaceDensity + face.meshVolumeRate, divided by max(oldVolume,OfSmall). meshVolumeRate derives from sweptVolume and gasGeometry.interval, not substage dt.
